reviewed_records.label: Open Menu
reviewed_records.depicts: Three horizontal bars stacked like a hamburger menu.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Can be confused with list, reorder, or drag-handle patterns if used outside app-shell context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show the main menu, navigation drawer, or app-level menu entry point.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to open or indicate the main navigation menu, drawer, or app shell menu.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for sortable lists, drag handles, or generic content lists with no menu meaning.

reviewed_records.label: Close Surface
reviewed_records.depicts: A large X mark used as a close control.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Without nearby UI context, the X shape can be mistaken for failure, remove, or cancel.
reviewed_records.purpose: Close, dismiss, or collapse an open surface such as a modal, drawer, or panel.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user can close an open surface, overlay, drawer, or panel.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for error, rejection, or blocked states where the X is a status symbol rather than a surface control.

reviewed_records.label: Go Home
reviewed_records.depicts: A simple house silhouette with a doorway.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The house shape is widely understood as a home destination, so confusion risk is low.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show the home destination, root view, or primary landing area of the product.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user can return to the home screen, dashboard, or main landing area.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for literal housing, addresses, or storage locations unless the UI truly means home as a place.

reviewed_records.label: Search
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: This is one of the most widely understood search symbols, so confusion risk is low.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show search, lookup, or find behavior over content, records, or interface surfaces.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface opens search, triggers lookup, or signals that users can find content.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for scanning, inspection, or analytics-specific search when a more specialized icon communicates the meaning better.

reviewed_records.label: Settings
reviewed_records.depicts: A gear with a center hub.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The gear is widely used for settings, though it can occasionally drift into generic tools or system administration.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show settings, preferences, configuration, or system options.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user can open settings, change preferences, or manage configuration.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for repair tools, automation workflows, or system architecture concepts where a gear would be too generic.

reviewed_records.label: Back
reviewed_records.depicts: A left-pointing arrow with a return-like stem.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The shape strongly reads as back or previous navigation in interface context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show back navigation to the previous screen, view, or state.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user can return to the previous screen, previous step, or earlier navigation state.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for undo, reply, or export-left behavior unless the product deliberately maps those actions to back navigation.

reviewed_records.label: Forward Or Next
reviewed_records.depicts: A right-pointing arrow with a forward stem.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Can mean next, continue, or forward navigation depending on surrounding UI copy and placement.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show forward navigation, continue flow, or move to the next screen or step.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user should move to the next step, continue forward, or navigate deeper into a flow.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for launch, growth, or share actions when the arrow is not actually about forward movement in the interface.

reviewed_records.label: Binary Data
reviewed_records.depicts: Abstract bit-like shapes arranged as machine-level binary marks.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon is abstract enough that it can drift into generic technical complexity rather than a single exact concept.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show binary data, machine-level encoding, or low-level computational representation.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product needs to represent binary data, encoded output, or low-level machine-facing computation.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for general AI, agent behavior, or modular workflow concepts where the abstract bit pattern would be misleading.

reviewed_records.label: Modules
reviewed_records.depicts: A large rounded block with a smaller detached block above it.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The visual reads as modular pieces, but it stays broad enough to cover components, chunks, or system building blocks.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show modular building blocks, composable components, or system pieces that fit together.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface refers to modular components, system blocks, or composable units that make up a larger whole.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for storage, files, or AI agent behavior where the block motif is too generic.

reviewed_records.label: Code
reviewed_records.depicts: Angle-bracket code marks with a slash in the middle.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: This is a standard developer-facing code mark, so confusion risk is low.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show source code, markup, structured syntax, or developer-facing code views.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to represent code, markup, developer tooling, or source-view functionality.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for generic integration, workflow, or AI behavior where the code-specific brackets would be too narrow.

reviewed_records.label: Warning
reviewed_records.depicts: A triangle warning sign with a central attention mark.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The triangle shape clearly reads as caution or warning rather than generic failure.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a warning, caution, or elevated-risk state that needs attention.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the system needs to surface a warning, caution, or elevated-risk condition.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for success, prohibition, or hard failure when another status icon would be more precise.

reviewed_records.label: Power
reviewed_records.depicts: A circular power-button symbol with a vertical line at the top.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The mark clearly relates to power, but the exact meaning can shift between on/off control, availability, or session state depending on context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show power control, system on-off state, or a start-stop control tied to availability.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface controls or indicates a power-related state such as start, shutdown, or availability.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for generic enabled settings, success states, or simple toggle behavior where the meaning is not truly power-related.
